The image is a chest X-ray, which primarily visualizes the thoracic cavity (lungs, heart, ribs). However, the upper portion of the abdomen is also visible at the bottom of the image. Specifically, the diaphragm separates the thorax from the abdomen, and below the diaphragm, one can see the gastric bubble (stomach) and potentially parts of the liver or spleen shadow. Therefore, organs that exist in the abdomen are indeed present in the image, specifically in the lower region.
